original_value: Compact fictional archive capsule for everyday document transport and offline backups. USB-C connected, thumb-drive class, with a 128GB capacity and matte ceramic finish. Designed as a generic portable flash storage device rather than an internal SSD or HDD.

result.paraphrase: Compact fictional archive capsule for transporting documents and keeping offline backups. USB-C connected and thumb-drive class, it offers 128GB capacity and a matte ceramic finish. Intended as a generic portable flash storage device, not an internal SSD or HDD.
